issues.description: The solution implementation of toString() uses the signature 'public Object toString()' which does not match the expected java.lang.Object.toString() overridden return type (String). The problem statement asks students to implement a custom toString() (returning a String as in the example), and the template expects them to add such a method. Declaring toString() to return Object prevents correctly overriding Object.toString() and will cause a compilation error or unexpected behavior for students using the solution as reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() method signature in the solution to 'public String toString()' (and keep the @Override annotation). Ensure the method returns a String as shown in the problem statement example. For example: '@Override public String toString() { return "Lecture{" + ... + '}'; }'.
